text: The purpose of this report is to request authority to amend Contract No. 47018546, issued to Roy Foss Chevrolet Buick GMC for the non-exclusive supply and delivery of latest model 4WD Chevrolet Tahoes with Special Service Package for Toronto Paramedic Services (TPS) and Toronto Fire Services, in the amount of $684,865, excluding all taxes and charges (or $696,919 net of HST recoveries), increasing the current contract from $819,629 to $1,504,494 excluding all taxes and charges. This amendment is required for TPS to purchase in total an additional sixteen (16) latest model 4WD Chevrolet Tahoes, 6 units in 2018 and 10 units in 2019, to support the Division's Community Paramedicine Wellness Clinics and Home Visit Program, and to meet TPS' growth in operational demand as a result of a growing and aging population. The Community Development and Recreation Committee: 1. In accordance with Section 71-11.1.C of the City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 71 (Financial Control Bylaw), granted authority to amend Contract No. 47018546 with Roy Foss Chevrolet Buick GMC by an additional amount of $684,865 excluding all taxes and charges, ($696,919 net of HST recoveries) increasing the current contract value from $819,629 to $1,504,494 excluding all taxes and charges (or net of HST recoveries from $834,055 to $1,530,973).
